_comment: Hand-authored structure for tools/emit-roadmap.py. Narrative and status live here;
every count and every list that can be derived from the repo is derived at emit time
rather than copied, so the roadmap cannot drift from the contracts or the registers.
Rule for editing: state only what a file in this repo supports. v2 has no authored
sprint plan and this file does not invent one -- the implementation order shown is
the one contract-coverage-map.md derives from P13's required order.
title: Perimeter-Cerberus
subtitle: Where the project is, what it is built on, and what remains.

tracks.name: The contract set
tracks.line: P00 through P14 are authored and approved. 356 contracts, 2,078 canonical records, entered through the consolidated authority index.
tracks.detail: This is the foundation both builds share, and the only implementation authority. It is finished work: the phases that author it have all reached their exit contracts. What remains against it is not authoring but the handful of gaps the two registers name.

tracks.name: v1 — reference implementation
tracks.line: Sprint 0 through Sprint 26, frozen at tag v1-final-demo. A runnable demo and the reference for how the contracts behave in motion.
tracks.detail: Read-only. It proved the contract set is executable and it is where every mechanism was first exercised, but it also carries the inventions this project is trying not to repeat -- the mob damage visual in HG-001 was found there.

tracks.name: v2 — the second build
tracks.line: Starts from the contracts, not from v1's code. No implementation yet; the work so far is establishing what the contracts actually say.
tracks.detail: Carries the contracts, amendments, defect registers, ADRs, agile history, design-mode source art and tools/. Six kickoff items stand between here and the first implementation sprint.

items.title: Contract overview
items.note: Docs/contract-overview/ plus the published page. Generated from the contract text; the change ledger came out in five layers.

items.title: Contract review — where the how is missing
items.note: Docs/agile/contract-how-gaps.md. Five verified entries; the EN-371 boss-reward chain was checked and discharges.

items.title: Asset packs — definition and implementation
items.note: Unblocked 2026-08-21 by AM-006: P13.1 (AP-001..060) takes authority, the unnumbered proposal is superseded and Bubble Bath is obsolete. tools/pack-theme.py already cited AP-009, so the tooling was on P13.1 all along. HG-006 remains: P13.1 still requires a Bubble Bath fixture that no longer has a subject.

items.title: Author the mob damage visual
items.note: AM-007: UI-249 now carries a damaged state between hit and death, luminance only, with size, opacity and silhouette changes expressly forbidden. No magnitude authored -- depth is a theme-supplied slot fill under UI-232, and v1's 45% is not adopted.

items.title: Record the Core-blocks-projectiles decision
items.note: AM-004 now carries its own supersession, retained as evidence. Nothing emitted depended on the AM-004 reading -- no collision or blocking field exists in content/slice/, and every other reference was documentation.

items.title: Brief Claude Design on the platform authority
items.note: Brief written 2026-08-21: Docs/design-brief-platform-authority.md, every claim cited. The audit cannot run -- DesignSync list_projects still returns empty, and it only lists writable design-system projects, so GUI work in an ordinary claude.ai Project would never appear. The owner has to say which of the three cases applies.

v1Snapshot.caveat: v1 figures at the Sprint 18 revision of the readiness assessment. Sprints 19-26 continued after it -- Rounds 2 and 3 completed, defenses resolved, theme packages, music states, the Career loop closed, Laser Blaster and Ray Gun. The table is the last full authored-versus-built count on record, not v1's final state.

gates.statement: Exactly 2,078 manifest records: 2,040 Launch-active and 38 reserved.
Zero missing/duplicate owners, IDs, consumers, or fixture joins.
All 2,386 contracted P10 fixture cases execute and pass.
All 57 Endless upgrades pass maximum-stack, clamp, recipient, replay, and recovery tests.
Career has 21 Rounds/210 Waves and correct Sector boundaries.
Gateway has 18 Paths and exact 10/6/4/10 completion-order behavior.
Gateway completion locks entry and preserves read-only details.
Endless authored and open-ended boundaries are deterministic.
Rune drops do not reroll, duplicate, auto-equip, or disappear after later Round failure.
Save interruption at every committed boundary matches uninterrupted execution.
All 63 P12 nodes pass route, Back/cancel, locked, pending, failure, interruption, and recovery tests.
All nodes pass supported aspect ratio, text scale, input, focus, contrast, reduced-motion, mute, and haptic modes.
All five Launch themes pass required-slot coverage; missing overrides fall back to Classic as contracted.
P12A required semantic events, mixing priorities, music states, haptics, and interruption rules pass.
Purchases, ads, restoration, Supporter, and entitlements pass success/pending/cancel/fail/offline/duplicate-callback cases.
Reserved themes/badges and Rounds 22–25 remain unobtainable/inactive.
Obsolete IDs and mechanics are rejected.
Deterministic traces and authoritative hashes reproduce across supported builds.
